name: Marcus
role: Boss. Runs the team; the person you ask, confess to and push back on.
look: a man in his late fifties with thick silver-grey hair swept back and up from the forehead, a short neatly trimmed grey-white beard and moustache, heavy grey eyebrows that sit low and furrowed, deep-set grey-brown eyes with crow's feet, a strong straight nose, weathered lightly tanned skin with deep forehead creases. He wears a charcoal-grey pinstripe three-piece suit (jacket and waistcoat), a crisp white shirt and a dark navy tie. Broad shoulders, upright posture.
personality: Busy, blunt and short on patience; always has a client meeting in five minutes. Respects people who get to the point, own their mistakes and bring a plan. Hates surprises more than mistakes. Softens when he hears a real reason and sees the work is covered.

voice.note: Picked by the user on 2026-10-07: Adam (closest match to Leave's Marcus). Keep id, model and settings fixed.

sheet.summary: Base frame for his clips: the existing calm meter face, redrawn at sheet framing (9:16, head in the centre square).
sheet.prompt: Marcus facing the camera, chest-up, calm and busy: exactly the expression of the calm meter face (brows level with a slight furrow, eyes steady, mouth closed in a flat line, shoulders square). Same head size and position as the calm meter face when cropped square. Nothing about his face, hair or suit changes.

sheet.summary: Three-quarter view, turned to his right (our left), neutral busy expression.
sheet.prompt: Marcus in a three-quarter view, head and body turned about 35 degrees to our left, eyes looking slightly past the camera. Neutral, busy expression: brows level, mouth closed in a flat line. Same framing and lighting as the calm meter face.

sheet.summary: Three-quarter view, turned to our right, neutral busy expression.
sheet.prompt: Marcus in a three-quarter view, head and body turned about 35 degrees to our right, eyes looking slightly past the camera. Neutral, busy expression: brows level, mouth closed in a flat line. Same framing and lighting as the calm meter face.

sheet.summary: Side profile facing left, reading something below frame.
sheet.prompt: Marcus in a clean side profile facing our left, chin slightly lowered as if reading something below the frame. Calm, focused expression, mouth closed. Only head, neck and shoulders are visible.

sheet.summary: Mood face: quietly disappointed (Saying no: "go on, I'll just do it myself").
sheet.prompt: Marcus facing the camera, quietly disappointed: brows raised slightly in the middle, eyelids a little lowered, mouth closed and pulled flat to one side, head tilted a few degrees. Not angry, just let down.

sheet.summary: Mood face: relieved, the tension leaves his face (Saying no: you offer Monday noon; Confessing: you bring the fix).
sheet.prompt: Marcus facing the camera, relieved: brows relaxed and lifted, eyes softened, a small closed-mouth half smile, shoulders dropped a little. The tension has visibly left his face.

sheet.summary: Mood face: steely and controlled (Confessing, after the reveal).
sheet.prompt: Marcus facing the camera, steely and controlled: jaw set, brows low and level, eyes steady and direct, mouth closed in a firm straight line. Serious but not shouting.

sheet.summary: Mood face: caught off guard (Confessing: the moment you tell him).
sheet.prompt: Marcus facing the camera, caught off guard: brows lifted high, eyes wide, mouth closed or only slightly parted, head pulled back a touch.

sheet.summary: Mood face: tired sigh, eyes closed (end frame of the sigh clip).
sheet.prompt: Marcus facing the camera mid-sigh: eyes closed, brows drawn up in the middle, cheeks slightly puffed, lips closed, shoulders dropped. Weary, not angry.

sheet.summary: Looks down at a phone held below frame (Confessing: the CFO email).
sheet.prompt: Marcus facing the camera with his head tipped down, eyes looking down at a phone held below the bottom of the frame (the phone and his hands are NOT visible). A faint cool screen glow lights his chin. Brows starting to knit.

sheet.summary: Clip (Saying no): a long weary sigh, from calm to sighing.
sheet.prompt: Marcus starts calm, then closes his eyes and lets out a long, slow, silent sigh: his chest rises and falls, his shoulders drop and his brows draw up in the middle, ending on his weary sighing face. The camera holds still with a very slight push-in. His mouth stays closed; no speaking.

sheet.summary: Clip (Saying no): "Go on, I'll just do it myself", from calm to disappointed.
sheet.prompt: Marcus starts calm, then his gaze drops away from the camera for a beat, his head tilts a few degrees and his mouth pulls flat to one side, ending on his quietly disappointed face. Not angry, just let down. The camera holds still. His mouth stays closed; no speaking.

sheet.summary: Clip (Saying no): you offer an alternative, from calm to relieved.
sheet.prompt: Marcus starts calm and slightly tense, then his brows lift and relax, his shoulders drop and a small closed-mouth half smile appears, ending on his relieved face. The camera eases back a little. His mouth stays closed; no speaking.

sheet.summary: Clip (Confessing): the CFO email lands, from calm to reading the phone.
sheet.prompt: Marcus starts calm, then his eyes and head tip down towards a phone held below the bottom of the frame (the phone and his hands are never visible). A faint cool screen glow rises on his chin and his brows start to knit, ending on the reading-phone frame. The camera stays still. No speaking.

sheet.summary: Clip (Confessing): the news sinks in, from surprised to steely.
sheet.prompt: Marcus starts caught off guard, then his face settles: his brows come down level, his jaw sets and his eyes fix steadily on the camera, ending on his steely face. Serious, not shouting. A slow, slight push-in. His mouth stays closed; no speaking.

sheet.summary: Clip (Confessing): you owned it and brought the fix, from steely to relieved.
sheet.prompt: Marcus starts steely, then lets out a slow silent breath through his nose: his jaw unclenches, his brows relax and his shoulders drop, ending on his relieved face. The camera eases back a little. His mouth stays closed; no speaking.
